prompt: A mobile e-commerce home page screen design (portrait phone UI, 390px wide layout), for the lifting-strap brand ONE PERCENT (tagline BETTER DAILY), styled as an exploded-view engineering drawing on near-black #0B0B0C with a faint graphite grid. Regions top to bottom: (1) hairline title-block header: "1%" circle logo with purple arc left, "CART (0)" right in small wide-tracked caps. (2) Small caps eyebrow "FIG. 01 / EXPLODED VIEW" then a heavy all-caps headline "EVERY PART, MEASURED." (3) The dominant hero, taking two thirds of the screen: the black lifting strap from the first reference image shown vertically as an exploded view, its parts separated and floating apart along one vertical axis: the neoprene wrist cuff with the black ONE PERCENT logo patch at top, the two silver D-rings pulled out beside it, the silicone-dotted strap below; numbered circles 1 to 4 on thin white leader lines point to each part, with a small parts list at the right edge: "1 CUFF 38.5CM", "2 DOUBLE D-RING", "3 5MM NEOPRENE", "4 SILICONE STRAP 30CM". One purple #9B5DE5 dimension line measures the strap. (4) Bottom: "$39.95" and a full-width flat square purple #9B5DE5 "ADD TO CART" button with black caps text. White linework, Montserrat caps, extreme scale contrast between huge headline and tiny labels, square corners, no cards, no gradients, no glow, no people. Logo and colours from the second reference image. Premium, precise UI screenshot. [Magnific Nano Banana Pro 2k 9:16; refs: spec sheet, packaging blueprint]
